description: Create an activity in Pipedrive (e.g. Probenahme, Ortsbesichtigung, Wiedervorlage). subject and type are required (type is one of the tenant's configured activity type keys — see list_pipedrive_activity_types). Pass any additional Pipedrive field in `fields`, keyed by its field key/name (call the matching list_pipedrive_*_fields tool first to discover custom field keys and, for enum/set fields, their option ids). Common fields: due_date (YYYY-MM-DD), due_time (HH:MM), duration (HH:MM), deal_id, person_id, org_id, note, done (0|1), attendees. INVITATIONS (ticket 442c7dd3): Pipedrive e-mails a calendar invitation to the GUESTS (fields.attendees: [{email_address, name}]) through the calendar sync of the activity OWNER (user_id). So to put a colleague on a site visit, keep the owner a user with Pipedrive calendar sync (usually the one who books it, e.g. the office manager) and add the colleague as attendee — do NOT just switch user_id to the colleague: then they are owner and organizer of their own event and nobody is invited. Set attendees when CREATING the activity; guests added later by an update are not reliably invited. Never set org_id to the own company.

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)

type.description: Activity type key configured for the tenant (see list_pipedrive_activity_types)
